verdict.rationale: A federal corporate registry could plausibly publish versioned APIs, so the axis applies. The probe found that the registry itself documents no transactional API on any surface checked, and nothing in the pack mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy. The keyless CKAN endpoint on open.canada.ca is a separate national open-data platform, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
